notes.title: New Patch
notes.content:
1 April 2019 10:00am~  
50% Sale!

Update-
Delete level result UI
The ghost will die but revive.
When you acquire the soul, the mental is raised.
When you hide under the bed, you can see more widely.
Overall difficulty has been reduced.

Thank you.

notes.title: Update.
notes.content:
Game play update.
-Now the ghosts are not spawned.
-Ghosts are do not die.
-Just run away from it.
-The flashlight slows down ghosts.
-Lights will heal you. Under the bed too.
-Combo waiting time 5->10 sec 
-Safe zone deleted.
-You can hide clothes and plant.

Thanks.
